title: TheySix Events launches
summary: TheySix Events went live with a full role hierarchy, five leaderboards, King of the Week, and nineteen minigames to test.
description: The TheySix Events system is now live, bringing in-game roles, leaderboards, weekly competitions, and new message components to the server.

body.text: We added a full set of in-game roles for TheySix Events so everyone has a clear place in the community.
Rolled out Components V2 messages across the server for a cleaner look and feel.
Five new leaderboards track the top players in each category.
King of the Week celebrates the player who won the most games in 1st place.
Added nineteen new minigames for everyone to try out.
